entries.appliesTo: local school boards / public school divisions (acceptable internet use policies and internet safety instruction)

dutySources.registration-filing: § 22.1-70.2(A) — 'each local school division shall certify compliance with these requirements annually to the Department of Education'

sources.curriculum: § 22.1-70.2(A)(v) — 'that includes instruction on key modern digital safety topics, including online scams, misinformation, and content generated by artificial intelligence'
sources.policyRequired: § 22.1-70.2(A) — 'each local school board shall review, amend if necessary, and approve the school division's acceptable use policy'

flags: AI content is one added instruction topic ('content generated by artificial intelligence') inside a pre-existing internet-safety statute; most of the reenacted section (filtering, illegal-material prohibitions) is not AI-specific
subsection C imposes a filtering-technology duty on certain private schools accepting federal funds for internet access — pre-existing, not AI-related, no listed duty/param fits
subsection D directs the Superintendent of Public Instruction to issue guidelines 'on the topics specified in clause (v) of subsection A' — duty on a state official, not on the bound schools
no penalty or enforcement provision in the text — exposure omitted (silence)
